title: Vishwarupa Darshana Yoga
translation: The Yoga of the Vision of the Universal Form
summary: At Arjuna's request, Krishna reveals His magnificent and terrifying Universal Form (Vishwarupa), encompassing the entire cosmos and all beings within Himself.

verses.sanskrit:
दिवि सूर्यसहस्रस्य भवेद्युगपदुत्थिता |
यदि भाः सदृशी सा स्याद्भासस्तस्य महात्मनः || १२ ||
verses.translation: If hundreds of thousands of suns were to rise at once into the sky, their radiance might resemble the effulgence of the Supreme Person in that universal form.
verses.transliteration:
divi sūrya-sahasrasya bhaved yugapad utthitā
yadi bhāḥ sadṛśī sā syād bhāsas tasya mahā-tmanaḥ
verses.meaning: Divi - in the sky; Surya - suns; Sahasrasya - of thousands...
